control.subhead: Notra is a GEO tool that asks ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini the questions your buyers ask. It shows whether you appear, who appears instead and how to fix it.

visibility.subhead: See which prompts your buyers ask AI, whether you show up in the answer and exactly what to publish to win the ones you lose.

slack.subhead: Ask Notra in Slack how your brand shows up in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. It replies in the thread with the prompts you lose and drafts the pages that win them back, ready to approve without leaving Slack.

claude.subhead: Notra is a verified Claude connector. Ask Claude where your brand appears in AI answers, who shows up instead and what to publish next, all from the chat you already use.

claude-expert.subhead: Connect Notra to Claude and ask how your brand shows up in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Claude finds the prompts you lose and drafts the pages that win them back.

chatgpt.subhead: Notra is a ChatGPT app. Ask ChatGPT where your brand appears in AI answers, who shows up instead and what to publish next, all from the chat you already use.

chatgpt-expert.subhead: Connect Notra to ChatGPT and ask how your brand shows up in ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. ChatGPT finds the prompts you lose and drafts the pages that win them back.
